Technical report v0.4 on keeping personal AI participation, work-bound organizational coordination and bounded task execution distinguishable across role change, revocation, offboarding, replacement, correction, delegation, cancellation and recovery.

Claim ceiling: conceptual synthesis and evaluation design; 24 inert scenario definitions, 0 executed episodes; no integrated implementation, empirical superiority, economic advantage, identity-continuity result or c-specific formation effect.
